advisor.hypothesis:
The residual failure is NOT a bulk layer-count deficit: round1 already extruded 8468/8584 body faces (98.65%). The shortfall is a LOCAL defect. Round0 used 8 layers and reached only 0.33% coverage; round1 used 7 layers and reached 89.83% coverage with 86.7% of area at exactly 7 layers. So extrusion is all-or-nothing per face. The failing faces carry 0-4 layers, and layer_shortfall:0 / layer_shortfall:1 show why: they are the blunt fore/aft bands (x≈-1.59..-1.13 and x≈1.13..1.59) where solid normal half-thickness is only ~0.195-0.254 m and the measured median local feature is ~0.43 m, while the requested stack is 0.0160 m. Native log shows the medial-axis mover is NOT thickness-truncating ("Reducing layer thickness at 0 nodes"), and it reports "isolated points extrusion stopped : 4" plus "Disabled extrusion at" on 3 ranks. Mechanism hypothesis: the polar/aft band columns are stopped by the interaction of (a) featureAngle 60 with the tessellated cap curvature, which suppresses extrusion near surface "features" that are really smooth curvature, and (b) normal smoothing being too weak (n_smooth_surface_normals 1, n_smooth_normals 3) to produce a coherent extrusion direction across the cap, plus medial-axis angle 90 being restrictive for a blunt body whose fluid medial distance from the cap is comparable to the local feature.
